request.spec:
The remainder of a pool's cuts now goes to the member with the smallest non-zero cut, the latest
added on a tie (a member with no cut gets none; a pool with no non-zero cut gives it to the last
member with a share).
request.prompt:

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The remainder of a pool's cuts now goes to the member with the smallest non-zero cut, the latest

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.

agent.result_text:
A pool's leftover cents now go to the member with the smallest non-zero cut, and on a tie to the one added latest. `bin/e2e` passes all 4 tests.

The change is all in `cut(...)` in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/pool/PoolService.java`. It works out each member's rounded cut and then hands the remainder to that member. The front end shows the cuts the server sends, so it needed no change.

- **Members with no cut** (retired, held, or outside their dates) never get the remainder.
- **No non-zero cut at all:** the remainder goes to the last member with a share. The request doesn't say whether that counts held or retired members, so I took it to mean the last member still sharing the pot, i.e. not retired, held or outside their dates. The tests don't cover this case, so say if you meant any member with a share.
- **No member sharing the pot:** every cut stays 0.00, as before.

I also updated the class and method comments, which still described the old rule (largest share, earliest added).
